item.title: Honolulu police investigate car fire in Makaha
item.description: Honolulu police are investigating an arson after a car was set on fire in the Makaha area Saturday night.

item.title: Pope Leo urges U.S. and Cuba to engage in sincere dialogue
item.description: VATICAN CITY >> Pope Leo said today he was deeply concerned about rising tensions between the United States and Cuba, and he called for “sincere and effective dialogue” to prevent violence and further suffering for the Cuban people.

item.title: Police search for multiple suspects in armed robbery at Makapuu
item.description: Two men were robbed at gunpoint between Makapuu Beach and Baby Makapuu Beach early this morning, Honolulu police said.

item.title: Starmer: Ex-Prince Andrew should testify over alleged Epstein ties
item.description: TOKYO >> British Prime Minister Keir Starmer said on Saturday that the former Prince Andrew should testify before a U.S. congressional committee, following new revelations about Andrew’s links to the late financier and sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: U.S. doubles luger Kirkby is looking for love at the Olympics
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, Italy >> U.S. women’s doubles luger Sophia Kirkby is single and looking for love as she prepares for the biggest date in her sporting career with her discipline’s debut at this month’s Milano Cortina Olympics.

item.title: Iran warns of regional conflict if U.S. attacks
item.description: DUBAI >> Iran’s leadership warned of a regional conflict today if the U.S. were to attack it, stoking the tension between Washington and Tehran, and it designated EU armies as “terrorist groups” in a retaliatory move.

item.title: Washington scolds Cuba after crowds heckle U.S. diplomat
item.description: HAVANA >> The United States on Sunday accused Cuba of interfering with the work of its top diplomat in Havana after small groups of Cubans jeered at him during meetings with residents and church representatives outside the capital. item.title: Johnson says he has votes to end partial shutdown by Tuesday
item.description: WASHINGTON >> U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson said today he believes he has the Republican votes to end a partial government shutdown within days.

item.title: Grammys 2026: The complete list of winners and nominees
item.description: LOS ANGELES >> This year’s Grammy Awards are sure to be defined by historic firsts and lasts.

item.title: Lost hiker on Moanalua Ridge Trail rescued by airlift
item.description: Honolulu firefighters rescued a lost hiker Sunday afternoon after he became stranded on a steep hillside off the Moanalua Ridge Trail.
